name: Create Telegram bot
description: Creates a Telegram bot that acts as you and starts it immediately. Get a token from @BotFather, store it as a secret (v/ops/secret/set, e.g. TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN) and pass it as token "s/TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN" — literal tokens are refused. Choose exactly one inbound handler: agent (one agent:chat conversation per Telegram chat with an agent you own) or operation (every Telegram Update is handed to that operation, with reply true|false|"fixed text"). Access is fail-closed: list Telegram user ids / @usernames in allow, or set open: true. An allow-listed bot in turn only messages the users on its list and converses only in private chats; an @username resolves to its account the first time that person writes, and from then on means that account. The bot is recorded in the venue-private adapter workspace under users/<your-did>/bots/<name> and comes back after a venue restart; delete it with v/ops/telegram/delete. Requires telegram/manage on <you>/telegram/<name>. Bots that act as another identity are declared by the operator in venue config, not here.

name.description: Bot name, unique among your bots ([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)

token.description: Secret reference to the BotFather token, e.g. s/TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN

agent.description: Agent id to converse with (one session per Telegram chat). Exclusive with operation.

operation.description: Operation reference invoked with each Telegram Update. Exclusive with agent.

reply.description: For operation handlers: true (send the result, default), false (silent), or a fixed acknowledgement

allow.description: Telegram user ids and/or @usernames allowed to talk to the bot. Unless open, the bot only messages these users (an @username becomes addressable once that person has written to the bot: the account is remembered and a later holder of the handle is refused), and group chats are ignored

parseMode.description: Reply formatting; omit for plain text. An agent writes Markdown, which none of these modes renders as written: use replyOperation v/ops/telegram/format instead, whose HTML the reply then uses

mediaOperation.description: Optional agent-only operation invoked per downloaded attachment as the bot owner, with {kind, file_id, ref, mediaType, caption, via, ...}. Return an object: {} leaves the attachment untouched; optional non-empty text supplies a transcript/extraction; other structured results are retained under attachment.result without overwriting Telegram metadata. No provider is chosen implicitly.

replyOperation.description: Optional agent-only reply formatter. Invoked as the bot owner with {response, via}; return a non-empty string or {text: non-empty string, parse_mode?}; a parse_mode returned wins over parseMode. Formats the Telegram reply without changing the stored agent response. Errors do not fall back to sending the unformatted response. v/ops/telegram/format turns an agent's Markdown into Telegram HTML.

output.description: The bot's status record (as in telegram:bots): name, user, target, state, managed: runtime, ...
